finding.headline: "The Sensitive-Skin Panic"
finding.problem: "The Instagram baby wash gave him a rash. His skin is dark and dry and I don't know what's safe here. The clinics sell things I can't pronounce."
finding.person: African baby with eczema-prone skin; reacts to scented imported washes; needs a minimal, hypoallergenic, locally-available routine.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (Nigeria skin-care minimal list).". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
